context.title: Indivisible — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements (California picks only)

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 22

positions.statement: "Randy Villegas" — "Endorsed by Indivisible". "We’re proud to stand with La Raza Indivisibles to support Villegas in his run to be the next Representative for California’s 22nd district."

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 14

positions.statement: "Dr. Aisha Wahab" — "Endorsed by Indivisible". "Split a donation today between Indivisible Action and Dr. Aisha Wahab to support her campaign and all of our GOTV efforts from the primary through the general election."
